mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS subscriptions ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, plan_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, start_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, expire_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscriptions (user_id, plan_name, start_time, expire_time) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{planName}, TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' + INTERVAL '30 DAYS' )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, plan_name, start_time, expire_time FROM subscriptions ORDER BY id ASC
